2026_04_KC_LV.headline: Kansas City’s passing rhythm collides with an undefeated Raiders defense built on disruption
2026_04_KC_LV.paragraph1: Las Vegas reaches the rivalry game unbeaten, with a defense that has produced sacks and takeaways at a high rate through three weeks. Kansas City arrives after an encouraging start offensively and now faces the challenge of keeping Patrick Mahomes clean against a Raiders front that can change possessions quickly. The Raiders’ own offense must stay efficient enough to prevent Kansas City from controlling tempo. Protection, turnover avoidance and third-down execution should decide whether Las Vegas can keep the game in its preferred physical script.
2026_04_KC_LV.model_rationale: Las Vegas can create volatility with pressure and takeaways, but Kansas City’s ability to protect Mahomes and avoid negative plays is the clearest counter to that defensive strength.
